newsitem.title: USA: PAR sees 1997 growth below estimates.
newsitem.headline: PAR sees 1997 growth below estimates.

text.p: PAR Technology Corp said on Wednesday that "certain obstacles" encountered with its delivery of a new product to Burger King restaurants will keep 1997 growth below levels anticipated by outside analysts.
Revenue and earnings for the first quarter of 1997 will be less than in the same period a year ago. But growth will accelerate during the second half of the year, the company said.
PAR Technology provides transaction information processing solutions to the quick-service restaurant industry and other clients.
